'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female Gladiator NPC participating in the Hunt with Augusta. She can be found at the [[Hunter's Den]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(During [[By Sun's Burning Hand]])
:'''Bellona''': This one's no ordinary [[Corrosaurus]]. It's a lot tougher.
:'''Bellona''': And it's not just the beast. Something's wrong with this High Tide. The temperature, the pressure, even the way the wild Tacet Discords are stirring... It's all off.
:'''Bellona''': I can feel it in my gut. Something is getting closer, using this hunt as cover.
:'''Bellona''': Not a prey... but a hunter.
----
;(After)
:'''Bellona''': I knew something would come at us, but I didn't expect it to be that ferocious.
:'''Bellona''': Still, it's nothing but ashes now.
:{{DIcon}} Your instincts saved us all.
:'''Bellona''': Instinct is nothing compared to your valor.
:'''Bellona''': Septimont is lucky to have fearless hunters like you.
{{Dialogue End}}
